-- Additive schema draft. Integrator assigns the next migration number; never
-- replace an applied migration. All epoch timestamps are milliseconds.
CREATE TABLE oa_operators (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
 role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('owner','admin','member')),
 status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('invited','active','inactive')),
 version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE oa_bootstrap (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), claim_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, claimed_at INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE oa_tokens (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('magic','invite')),
 operator_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES oa_operators(id), operator_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
 issuer_id TEXT REFERENCES oa_operators(id), issuer_version INTEGER,
 return_to TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 consumed_at INTEGER, revoked_at INTEGER,
 CHECK((kind='invite' AND issuer_id IS NOT NULL AND issuer_version IS NOT NULL)
    OR (kind='magic' AND issuer_id IS NULL AND issuer_version IS NULL))
);
CREATE TABLE oa_sessions (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 operator_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES oa_operators(id), operator_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('native','review','oidc','password','dev')),
 source_token_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES oa_tokens(id),
 created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, revoked_at INTEGER
);
CREATE INDEX oa_sessions_operator ON oa_sessions(operator_id);
CREATE TABLE oa_external_identities (
 issuer TEXT NOT NULL, subject TEXT NOT NULL, operator_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES oa_operators(id),
 PRIMARY KEY(issuer, subject)
);
CREATE TABLE oa_limits (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, window INTEGER NOT NULL, count INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TRIGGER oa_preserve_last_owner_update BEFORE UPDATE OF status,role ON oa_operators
 WHEN OLD.role='owner' AND OLD.status='active' AND (NEW.role!='owner' OR NEW.status!='active')
 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oa_operators WHERE role='owner' AND status='active') <= 1
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'last_owner'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER oa_preserve_last_owner_delete BEFORE DELETE ON oa_operators
 WHEN OLD.role='owner' AND OLD.status='active'
 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oa_operators WHERE role='owner' AND status='active') <= 1
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'last_owner'); END;
-- A status/role change invalidates every preexisting session and link, including
-- after a later reactivation. Keep this invariant for direct administrative SQL.
CREATE TRIGGER oa_operator_version AFTER UPDATE OF status,role ON oa_operators
 WHEN OLD.status != NEW.status OR OLD.role != NEW.role
 BEGIN UPDATE oa_operators SET version=OLD.version+1 WHERE id=NEW.id; END;

-- Fresh installs include local dev identity. Apply schema/dev-sessions.sql as a
-- NEW numbered migration in existing stores; it is also safe after this file.
-- A credential minted while signed in with a dev session is recorded here and,
-- like the dev session itself, counts only behind the local key gate.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_dev_credentials (
 credential TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(credential, id)
);

-- Fresh installs include the additive invitation cancellation ledger.
-- Apply as a NEW numbered migration after operator-auth.sql in existing stores.
-- This durable record is admission state, not an expiring credential. Never prune it.
-- Existing active/inactive operators retain their recorded status: no historical
-- acceptance is inferred. Only a witnessed invited -> inactive transition records
-- an unaccepted cancellation, including direct administrative SQL transitions.
CREATE TABLE oa_invitation_cancellations (
 operator_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES oa_operators(id),
 operator_version INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TRIGGER oa_record_invitation_cancellation AFTER UPDATE OF status ON oa_operators
 WHEN OLD.status='invited' AND NEW.status='inactive'
 BEGIN INSERT INTO oa_invitation_cancellations(operator_id,operator_version)
 VALUES(NEW.id,OLD.version+1)
 ON CONFLICT(operator_id) DO UPDATE SET operator_version=excluded.operator_version; END;
CREATE TRIGGER oa_reject_cancelled_invitation_reactivation BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON oa_operators
 WHEN NEW.status='active' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oa_invitation_cancellations WHERE operator_id=OLD.id)
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'invitation_required'); END;

-- Fresh installs include domain rules and step-up proofs. Apply
-- schema/domain-rules-step-up.sql as a NEW numbered migration in existing
-- stores; it is also safe after this file.
-- A required sign-in provider for an email domain. Sign-ins for that domain by
-- any other route are refused; app owners are exempt.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_domain_rules (
 domain TEXT PRIMARY KEY, provider_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES oa_operators(id), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
-- A step-up proof: an app-local email link sent to the operator's own address,
-- bound to the session that asked and completed only in that session. No
-- foreign key names oa_sessions, which schema/dev-sessions.sql rebuilds.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_step_up_challenges (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 session_id TEXT NOT NULL, operator_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES oa_operators(id),
 operator_version INTEGER NOT NULL, action TEXT NOT NULL, return_to TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, consumed_at INTEGER
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS oa_step_up_session ON oa_step_up_challenges(session_id);

-- Identity providers (OpenID Connect). Apply as a NEW numbered migration after
-- the accounts schema. Every statement is IF NOT EXISTS, so a store that applied
-- an earlier version of this file applies the current one again as its next
-- migration and gains only what it lacks.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_transactions (
  state_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  binding_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  config_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_transactions_expiry ON oa_oidc_transactions(expires_at);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_limits (
  bucket TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  count INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
-- One pinned link per configured provider. Linking stores the issuer, JWKS URI,
-- client id, endpoints and allowed algorithms; a changed configuration only
-- records a pending re-link, which the owner completes with a step-up proof.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_identity_providers (
  provider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  preset TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('linked','unlinked')),
  issuer TEXT NOT NULL,
  client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  jwks_uri TEXT NOT NULL,
  authorization_endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
  algorithms TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_auth_method TEXT NOT NULL,
  response_iss INTEGER NOT NULL,
  interface_version TEXT,
  linked_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  pending_issuer TEXT,
  pending_client_id TEXT,
  pending_preset TEXT,
  pending_at INTEGER,
  jwks TEXT,
  jwks_fetched_at INTEGER
);
-- Reachability per configured provider, linked or not. A provider that has
-- failed discovery or JWKS for 5 minutes, or answered 404 or a DNS failure, is
-- hidden from the sign-in page until a later check succeeds.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_identity_provider_health (
  provider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  failing_since INTEGER,
  hard_failure_at INTEGER,
  checked_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);

migrations.sql:
-- Beam learning records. Progress, completion and demonstrated competence are
-- separate: lesson progress never completes a course by itself, and a completion
-- records what happened (method and evidence), never a competence judgement.

CREATE TABLE beam_business (
  singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  timezone TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);

-- Members are adult staff identified by their operator-auth email.
CREATE TABLE beam_members (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE beam_member_roles (
  member_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_members(id),
  role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('author', 'reviewer', 'learner', 'manager', 'assessor')),
  PRIMARY KEY (member_id, role)
);
CREATE TABLE beam_teams (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE beam_team_members (
  team_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_teams(id),
  member_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_members(id),
  PRIMARY KEY (team_id, member_id)
);

-- Owned source material: licence evidence and a responsible reviewer per source,
-- immutable content-addressed versions (bytes live in the FILES bucket).
CREATE TABLE beam_sources (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  licence TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (licence IN ('owned', 'licensed', 'permission')),
  licence_evidence TEXT NOT NULL,
  reviewer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_members(id),
  created_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_members(id),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE beam_source_versions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_sources(id),
  number INTEGER NOT NULL,
  filename TEXT NOT NULL,
  media_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  size INTEGER NOT NULL,
  sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
  provenance TEXT NOT NULL,
  uploaded_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_members(id),
  uploaded_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (source_id, number)
);

-- Evidence files attached to practical attempts and offline training records.
CREATE TABLE beam_attachments (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  filename TEXT NOT NULL,
  media_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  size INTEGER NOT NULL,
  sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
  uploaded_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_members(id),
  uploaded_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);

-- A course has one editable draft (version-checked) and immutable revisions.
CREATE TABLE beam_courses (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  reviewer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_members(id),
  created_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_members(id),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  draft_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  draft_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  published_revision_id TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE beam_course_revisions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  course_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_courses(id),
  number INTEGER NOT NULL,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  summary TEXT NOT NULL,
  draft_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('in_review', 'returned', 'published', 'superseded')),
  submitted_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_members(id),
  submitted_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  reviewed_by TEXT REFERENCES beam_members(id),
  reviewed_at INTEGER,
  review_note TEXT,
  reassignment TEXT,
  UNIQUE (course_id, number)
);
CREATE TABLE beam_lesson_revisions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  course_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_course_revisions(id),
  position INTEGER NOT NULL,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  body TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_version_ids TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (course_revision_id, position)
);
CREATE TABLE beam_assessment_revisions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  course_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES beam_course_revisions(id),
  questions_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  pass_percent INTEGER,
  max_attempts INTEGER,
  practical_instructions TEXT,
  assessor_id TEXT REFERENCES beam_members(id)
);

-- Role paths: each edit publishes a new path revision; assignments keep theirs.
CREATE TABLE beam_paths (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  team_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_teams(id),
  current_revision_id TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE beam_path_revisions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  path_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_paths(id),
  number INTEGER NOT NULL,
  created_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_members(id),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (path_id, number)
);
CREATE TABLE beam_path_requirements (
  path_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_path_revisions(id),
  position INTEGER NOT NULL,
  course_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_courses(id),
  prerequisite_course_id TEXT REFERENCES beam_courses(id),
  due_days INTEGER NOT NULL,
  renewal_days INTEGER,
  PRIMARY KEY (path_revision_id, course_id)
);

-- An assignment binds a learner, a requirement and an exact course revision,
-- with a due date in an explicit time zone.
CREATE TABLE beam_assignments (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  learner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_members(id),
  course_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_courses(id),
  course_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_course_revisions(id),
  path_revision_id TEXT REFERENCES beam_path_revisions(id),
  prerequisite_course_id TEXT REFERENCES beam_courses(id),
  renewal_days INTEGER,
  due_date TEXT NOT NULL,
  due_time TEXT NOT NULL,
  timezone TEXT NOT NULL,
  due_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('open', 'completed', 'replaced', 'cancelled')),
  reason TEXT NOT NULL,
  extra_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_lesson_id TEXT,
  assigned_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_members(id),
  assigned_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX beam_one_open_assignment ON beam_assignments(learner_id, course_id) WHERE status = 'open';
CREATE INDEX beam_assignments_learner ON beam_assignments(learner_id);

CREATE TABLE beam_lesson_progress (
  assignment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_assignments(id),
  lesson_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_lesson_revisions(id),
  completed_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (assignment_id, lesson_revision_id)
);

CREATE TABLE beam_attempts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  assignment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_assignments(id),
  assessment_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_assessment_revisions(id),
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('quiz', 'practical')),
  number INTEGER NOT NULL,
  submitted_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  score INTEGER,
  max_score INTEGER,
  passed INTEGER,
  scoring_rule TEXT NOT NULL,
  retry_decision TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('scored', 'awaiting_review', 'accepted', 'rejected')),
  evidence_text TEXT,
  attachment_id TEXT REFERENCES beam_attachments(id),
  UNIQUE (assignment_id, kind, number)
);
CREATE TABLE beam_responses (
  attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_attempts(id),
  question_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  answer_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  correct INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id, question_id)
);
CREATE TABLE beam_review_decisions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES beam_attempts(id),
  assessor_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_members(id),
  decision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (decision IN ('accepted', 'rejected')),
  note TEXT NOT NULL,
  decided_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE beam_completions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  assignment_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES beam_assignments(id),
  learner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_members(id),
  course_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_courses(id),
  course_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_course_revisions(id),
  assessment_revision_id TEXT REFERENCES beam_assessment_revisions(id),
  method TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('lessons', 'assessed', 'offline')),
  evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  completed_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER,
  recorded_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_members(id)
);
CREATE INDEX beam_completions_learner ON beam_completions(learner_id);

CREATE TABLE beam_offline_sessions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  course_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_courses(id),
  course_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_course_revisions(id),
  held_on TEXT NOT NULL,
  instructor TEXT NOT NULL,
  location TEXT NOT NULL,
  attested_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_members(id),
  attestation TEXT NOT NULL,
  attachment_id TEXT REFERENCES beam_attachments(id),
  recorded_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE beam_certificates (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  completion_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES beam_completions(id),
  number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  issuer TEXT NOT NULL,
  issued_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER
);

-- Procedure maintenance: a new source version flags courses citing an older
-- version; proposals carry the input versions they were prepared from.
CREATE TABLE beam_source_notices (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  course_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_courses(id),
  source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_sources(id),
  previous_version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_source_versions(id),
  new_version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_source_versions(id),
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('open', 'no_material_change', 'draft_updated')),
  note TEXT,
  decided_by TEXT REFERENCES beam_members(id),
  decided_at INTEGER,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (course_id, new_version_id)
);
CREATE TABLE beam_proposals (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  course_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_courses(id),
  base_draft_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  input_version_ids TEXT NOT NULL,
  prepared_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_members(id),
  agent TEXT,
  summary TEXT NOT NULL,
  draft_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('open', 'accepted', 'declined')),
  decided_by TEXT REFERENCES beam_members(id),
  decided_at INTEGER,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);

-- Imported history (move-in kits): original identifiers and labels retained,
-- written only through the import kit's journal.
CREATE TABLE beam_imported_history (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload TEXT NOT NULL,
  revision TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE beam_audit (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  actor TEXT NOT NULL,
  action TEXT NOT NULL,
  subject TEXT NOT NULL,
  detail TEXT NOT NULL
);

-- Work the owner's own agent prepares (through a preparation credential) or a
-- person drafts, and a person approves. Nothing in a proposal reaches staff,
-- assignments or courses until a human records the approval; the proposal row
-- keeps its inputs, reasons, exclusions, exact payload and the decision.
CREATE TABLE beam_agent_proposals (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('assignment_plan', 'reminders', 'scenario', 'question_plan', 'process_change')),
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  agent TEXT,
  prepared_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_members(id),
  via_agent INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (via_agent IN (0, 1)),
  inputs_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  reasons_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  excluded_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,

  decided_by TEXT REFERENCES beam_members(id),

  decision_note TEXT,
  result_json TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);

  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  assignment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_assignments(id),
  learner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_members(id),
  body TEXT NOT NULL,
  proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_agent_proposals(id),
  approved_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_members(id),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX beam_reminder_messages_learner ON beam_reminder_messages(learner_id);

-- Practice scenarios bound to one published course revision. Practice never
-- scores, never completes and never touches attempts or completions.
CREATE TABLE beam_scenarios (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  course_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_courses(id),
  course_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_course_revisions(id),

  rubric TEXT NOT NULL,
  steps_json TEXT NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE beam_practice_runs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  scenario_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_scenarios(id),
  learner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_members(id),
  choices_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX beam_practice_runs_learner ON beam_practice_runs(learner_id, scenario_id);

-- Question plans a manager approved. Invitations record only whether someone
-- answered or declined; answers carry no member and no time, and are read only
-- once the plan has closed with enough answers (src/beam/questions.ts).
CREATE TABLE beam_question_plans (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  purpose TEXT NOT NULL,
  questions_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  closes_on TEXT NOT NULL,
  closes_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  closed_at INTEGER,
  proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES beam_agent_proposals(id),
  approved_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_members(id),
  approved_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE beam_question_invites (
  plan_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_question_plans(id),
  member_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_members(id),
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('waiting', 'answered', 'declined')),
  PRIMARY KEY (plan_id, member_id)
);
CREATE TABLE beam_question_answers (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  plan_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beam_question_plans(id),
  answers_json TEXT NOT NULL
);
